title: MergeReadinessVerdict
description: Output of the Merge Judge: an independent decision, after the reviewer/implementer exchange has settled, on whether the change is ready for a human to review in GitLab. Consumes the spec, findings, responses, test results, and the deterministic checks. Never edits code.

result.description: ready: open the MR. another_round: send back to implementer with the listed findings. escalate: the loop is not converging or a decision needs a human.

judge_assessment.description: The judge's own view of who is right, with reasoning. Judges the exchange, not just the code.

deterministic_checks.description: Results the orchestrator computed and handed to the judge. The judge may not override a failing deterministic check.

summary_for_human.description: Becomes the top of the MR description. What changed, what was contested, what the human should look at first.
